img.1.description: A wide, dark forest-green graphic split into two zones. On the left, a small lowercase white serif wordmark 'garner' sits above a three-line white serif headline reading 'Choose your doctor with confidence'. On the right, a cluster of overlapping circular and oval vignettes contains flat, stylized illustrations of people: an older man with glasses in a teal shirt beside a woman with dark hair, a smiling woman in blue scrubs, a man in a white coat with a stethoscope, and a woman with brown hair in a green top. The vignettes overlap each other and bleed toward the right edge of the frame.
img.1.title: Garner 'Choose your doctor with confidence' illustrated share card
img.1.usage_note: Use as a social/OG share card, a link-preview thumbnail, or a supporting illustration card where a calm, trust-oriented healthcare message is needed alongside a brand wordmark. Works well at wide aspect ratios (roughly 1.9:1) and in contexts where the headline can remain legible at small sizes.

img.11.description: A small square image containing a stylized briefcase with a handle on top, filled with brown and tan tones and shaded with darker olive-brown on the lower and right portions. Centered on the briefcase face is a white plus sign (cross) enclosed inside a thin, low-contrast circular ring. A slim lighter vertical highlight appears near the left edge of the case. The background is plain white with no scene, shadow, or environment.
img.11.title: Brown Briefcase with White Medical Cross Icon
img.11.usage_note: Appropriate as a small decorative or category icon accompanying employer, benefits, healthcare-plan, insurance, or medical-administration content. Works as an inline accent next to a heading or within a feature/list card where a compact, non-photographic symbol is needed. Also plausible as a bullet marker or small badge in a grid of comparable line/flat icons.

img.12.description: A small square image with a white or off-white background containing a portrait-oriented dark green rounded-rectangle tile. Centered within the tile is a single white lowercase letter 'g' with a visible bowl and descender loop. No other text or imagery is legible. The tile has rounded corners and flat top and bottom edges, reading as an icon or logo tile rather than a perfect circle. The green appears predominantly solid at this resolution, though a subtle tonal variation is possible.
img.12.title: Dark green tile with white lowercase 'g'
img.12.usage_note: Use as a compact icon, logo mark, avatar, favicon, app symbol, or badge when a small brand or letter identifier is needed. It is best suited to centered, icon-sized placements.

img.13.description: Landscape-oriented raster preview on a white background. Centered in the frame is a small, monochrome medium-gray circular seal. The seal has a thick outer ring containing curved uppercase text and a bottom numeral; inside the ring is a smaller circular vignette with line-art details. The vignette appears to include a standing figure and vertical staff-like element, with indistinct landscape or tree forms around it. The seal occupies a small portion of the canvas, leaving large white margins. No other graphical elements, wordmarks, or lockups are visible.
img.13.title: City of Portland municipal seal logo on white
img.13.usage_note: Use when a neutral, grayscale seal or logo is needed to identify the City of Portland as a referenced organization in a partner, trust, or affiliation display, provided the relationship is accurate and permission is confirmed. It works on light backgrounds because the raster preview has a white field.

img.14.description: A grayscale logo lockup centered on a solid black background. The main word 'ADVANCE' is set in large, bold, italic, uppercase sans-serif letters. To its left are three forward-slash-like diagonal strokes. Below and aligned toward the right side of the main word is 'AUTO PARTS' in smaller, bold, italic, uppercase sans-serif letters. A small superscript mark follows 'ADVANCE' but is not clearly legible. The logo is light gray against black.
img.14.title: Advance Auto Parts grayscale wordmark logo on black background
img.14.usage_note: Use when a design library needs a recognizable Advance Auto Parts logo reference and the use is legally cleared, e.g., in a third-party logo list, employer/customer logo strip, or card where the relationship is verified. This specific raster is low-contrast on black; if placed on light backgrounds, verify an appropriate version exists.

img.15.description: A centered, monochrome gray logo lockup on a solid black background. At top is an abstract mark made of three angled, ribbon-like strokes forming a stylized zigzag or M shape. Below is the large uppercase wordmark MOHAWK in a serif-style face, followed by a small registered trademark symbol. Beneath that is the smaller uppercase sub-wordmark INDUSTRIES, INC. in a sans-serif-style face. The lockup is surrounded by generous black negative space.
img.15.title: Mohawk Industries Logo Lockup on Black
img.15.usage_note: Use when displaying the Mohawk Industries corporate logo as a standalone brand mark in a logo wall, partner/customer list, or brand attribution context, after verifying rights and relationship.

img.16.description: A photograph of a woman standing in a field at sunset. She is seen from behind, facing left, with her hair down and wearing a light-colored top. The sun is low on the horizon, creating a warm golden glow and a silhouette effect. Tall grass or crops fill the foreground, and the sky transitions from bright yellow near the sun to softer orange and blue tones above.
img.16.title: Woman in a field at sunset
img.16.usage_note: Use as a full-bleed or contained hero image when a warm, aspirational, outdoor-lifestyle mood is needed. Suitable for travel, wellness, or brand-story sections where the subject matter is secondary to atmosphere.

img.17.description: A single-line, horizontally centered wordmark reading 'Optum' set in a heavy, rounded sans-serif, rendered in flat medium gray on a plain white field. The initial 'O' is a perfect circular ring with a thin counter; the following letters ('p', 't', 'u', 'm') share the same weight and rounded terminals. The descender of the 'p' drops below the baseline of the remaining letters. The wordmark occupies roughly the middle third of the frame horizontally and about a third of the height vertically. There is generous, even white negative space on all four sides, with no other graphic elements, icons, taglines, borders, or texture.
img.17.title: Optum gray wordmark on white background
img.17.usage_note: Use as a reference or display element for the Optum brand lockup when illustrating healthcare-payer, insurer, or benefits-network context (for example, a partner/provider logo row, a benefits-navigation article, or a comparison graphic). It works as a clean, low-distraction card thumbnail or inline mark on a white or very light background.

img.18.description: A horizontal wordmark logo displaying the text "Benefitfocus" in a bold, rounded sans-serif typeface, accompanied by a registered trademark symbol (®) placed at the upper right after the final letter. The logo is solid gray on a plain white background.
img.18.title: Benefitfocus wordmark logo
img.18.usage_note: Use this logo when referring to Benefitfocus as a company, product, or partner. Ensure sufficient contrast and clear space around the mark.

img.19.description: A single-line, all-lowercase wordmark reading “garner” rendered in a very heavy geometric sans-serif style, set in one dark green/teal ink color. The letterforms are tightly spaced with large circular bowls; the “g” has a fully rounded bowl and a descender that hooks/loops down and to the left, extending below the baseline of the remaining letters. The “a” “r” “n” “e” “r” are of matching weight, with the final “r” terminating in a short outward arm. A small superscript “TM” sits at the upper-right, aligned near the cap/ascender height of the final letter and smaller than the wordmark letters. Everything is flat, single-color, with no gradients, shadows, outlines or decorative elements. The mark is shown against a plain light background in the supplied preview.
img.19.title: Lowercase “garner” wordmark in dark green ink with superscript TM
img.19.usage_note: A wordmark lockup intended to identify the source on surfaces where a horizontal, single-line brand name fits: site headers and navigation, footers, thin banner strips, email signatures, document headers, small badge/avatar slots where the aspect ratio allows. Its wide, short proportions suit shallow horizontal containers more than square tiles.

img.2.description: A centered smartphone mockup with a white screen displays a chat interface. The phone sits over a large mint/teal rounded rectangle on a white background. The screen header reads 'Garner Assistant' with a back arrow. Chat bubbles alternate: user messages in dark green right-aligned, assistant messages in light gray left-aligned. Three doctor profile cards appear with circular avatar photos, names, specialties, star ratings, distances, and complication-rate badges. Bottom input bar reads 'Send a message...' with paperclip and send icons. Status bar shows 9:41 and signal/wifi/battery icons.
img.2.title: Garner Assistant chat screen with hip orthopedic surgeon results
img.2.usage_note: Use to illustrate Garner Assistant provider search, in-network doctor recommendations, or chat-based healthcare navigation. Suitable for landing pages, feature explainers, product cards, and social posts about finding care.

img.20.description: A horizontal logo lockup centered on a plain white or very light background. The word 'Mercy' is set in medium gray, with a capital M followed by lowercase e-r-c-y. To the right of the wordmark is a gray cross/plus-like symbol made of intersecting rectangular bars, with a small square/block detail at the upper left. The lockup is surrounded by wide, even negative space. No other text or imagery is visible. The supplied preview is a downscaled, rasterized SVG preview; background transparency cannot be confirmed from the pixels alone.
img.20.title: Mercy Gray Wordmark with Cross Symbol on White
img.20.usage_note: Use in a partner logo strip, affiliations section, or healthcare credibility context when Mercy Health is a verified partner and usage rights are confirmed. Best on light backgrounds with generous clear space; optically align with adjacent logos in a logo wall.

img.22.description: A horizontal lockup centered on a plain white field. On the left is a single solid, filled circle rendered in a flat neutral mid-gray with no outline, gradient, highlight, or texture. Immediately to its right is the set text 'USA TODAY' in a heavy, tightly spaced, all-uppercase sans-serif face, in the same flat neutral mid-gray as the disc. Both the disc and the letters are horizontally aligned along a shared optical baseline; the disc's diameter is slightly taller than the cap height of the adjacent letters. The entire mark sits in the middle of a wide white area with generous, roughly equal empty margins on all four sides, so the lockup occupies only the central band of the frame and the surrounding white reads as deliberate negative space.
img.22.title: USA TODAY wordmark with leading gray disc on white
img.22.usage_note: Usage roles are separated from creative type: this asset is a logo by creative type, but it can serve in several usage roles — a press/'as featured in' logo strip, a social-proof logo row, a partner or media-credit block, a card or list thumbnail, or a small inline credibility mark beside a testimonial.

img.23.description: A monochrome, mid-gray interlocking monogram — a rounded-octagonal closed 'O' form with a 'U' form nested below and to the right — centered on a plain white field with wide margins on all four sides. A very small superscript-style mark sits at the lower-left of the 'O'.
img.23.title: Gray interlocking OU monogram on white
img.23.usage_note: The pixels are only the letterform plus a small secondary mark; they show no product UI, photography or illustration, so any product-relevance or audience reading must be recorded as a hypothesis rather than an observed fact.

img.24.description: A square abstract illustration composed of layered geometric forms, including a central circular shape, overlapping rounded rectangles, and triangular wedges. Colors include deep indigo, violet, warm coral, orange, and pale cream. The composition is centered and balanced, with soft gradients and flat color fields. No text, logos, or recognizable objects are visible.
img.24.title: Abstract Geometric Illustration with Warm and Cool Gradient Shapes
img.24.usage_note: Suitable for decorative backgrounds, section dividers, feature card imagery, or abstract brand accents in digital and editorial layouts.

img.25.description: The supplied preview renders as a uniform white field across the full frame. No shapes, strokes, gradients, textures, figures, text, logos, or edges are discernible at the delivered resolution. The original is reported as a 605x512 SVG that was rasterized and downscaled to 512px for preview; the resulting image is visually empty.
img.25.title: Untitled white-field illustration (no legible content recovered)
img.25.usage_note: Cannot be recommended on visual grounds. If the file is confirmed to be a genuine white or near-white vector graphic (e.g., a background wash, a white-on-transparent mark, or a matte layer), it could serve as a neutral background or spacer surface behind overlaid DOM content. Verify the source file before relying on it.

img.3.description: A medium shot shows a woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a dark navy button-up blouse. She is positioned behind a light wood desk, looking slightly up and to the viewer's left with a gentle smile. Her left hand rests on a stack of white papers at the right side of the desk; her right arm is bent near the papers. On the desk in the foreground are a dark smartphone lying flat on the left and a tablet lying flat in the center with a dark bezel. The tablet screen displays a small teal/light-green circular mark. The background is a bright room with white walls, an exposed white ceiling, a window on the left casting natural light, and two potted green plants in dark pots—one near the window on the left and one behind the desk on the right. The image has rounded corners and white/indeterminate corner areas.
img.3.title: Woman at a bright desk with papers, phone, tablet, and plants
img.3.usage_note: Use as a supporting lifestyle image for content about healthcare reimbursement, benefits administration, medical paperwork, digital tools for managing costs, or member/employee navigation of health benefits. It can work in cards, section headers, or article illustrations where a human, non-clinical desk setting is appropriate.

img.4.description: A simplified, stylized silhouette of the United States filled in a deep teal-green, with thin darker outlines delineating the boundaries of the contiguous 48 states. Many small, uniform, round white dots are scattered across the landmass, distributed fairly evenly but with visibly tighter groupings through the Northeast, Midwest, Southeast and coastal West, and sparser clusters through parts of the interior West. Alaska appears as a separate shape in the lower-left corner, with a further small chain/cluster of dots immediately to its lower right. The whole map sits inside a pale blue, generously rounded square card, and two subtly lighter blue rounded shapes overlap behind the map, one toward the upper-left and one toward the lower-right. The canvas is near-square (original 800 × 765). No legend, key, scale bar, state labels, caption, logo or other text is legible anywhere in the pixels.
img.4.title: Deep Teal U.S. Coverage Map with Scattered White Location Dots on a Pale Blue Rounded Card
img.4.usage_note: Use as a supporting section visual where a page needs to convey nationwide scale, breadth of coverage, or many discrete data points distributed across the country. It reads well as a quiet, low-detail accompaniment to a heading-and-paragraph block about database size, network reach or provider/location counts. Also works as a blog-header, slide or social-card image when no text is needed inside the frame.

img.6.description: A website-embedded photographic promo card with two rounded-square headshot crops placed side by side. Left portrait: a smiling man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a dark gray blazer over a light blue collared shirt, set against a dark/black portrait background. Right portrait: a smiling man with short brown hair, wearing a blue blazer over a light blue collared shirt, set against a white portrait background. Below each portrait is a left-aligned text block with a name, role, and company affiliation in white/light gray sans-serif type. The background is dark forest green with a large muted teal/blue-green angled geometric shape in the upper-left area. No product UI, logo mark, or central headline is visible in the pixels.
img.6.title: Two-Speaker Promo Card: Jake Shuster and Chad Schulz
img.6.usage_note: Use as a speaker announcement or event/webinar promo image where two named experts are introduced side by side. Suitable for landing pages, email headers, social cards, and editorial cards, especially for benefits strategy content aimed at finance and benefits leaders.

img.7.description: Layered mobile app screens on a dark green background. Center shows a dark green Visa debit card with 'garner', 'DEBIT', 'VISA' and a 'Hold Near Reader' contactless icon. Left shows a care-team profile with avatar, 'Katie Gibbs, Ch', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Added to Care Team', and bullet points about chronic conditions and high-risk patients. Right shows a map with green pins and 'Yes, near 10025'. Far-right shows sign-in UI with 'to Garner', 'our account', 'Sign in', and 'password?'.
img.7.title: Garner mobile app UI composite with debit card, care-team profile, map, and sign-in screens
img.7.usage_note: Use as a website hero/banner or product feature overview image. Works best in wide placements where layered app screens and dark green background remain visible.

img.9.description: A low-resolution, flat-style icon on a white-looking field: a blue-outlined magnifying glass tilted diagonally, its circular lens containing a small ascending green bar chart on a pale cream/peach circular field. The handle points down-left, is filled in a lighter blue with a white diagonal highlight stripe, and joins the lens ring through a short dark/near-black connector. Inside the lens, three green vertical bars increase in height from left to right, with a faint light line/arrow rising across the top of the taller bars. The lens rim is a fairly thick mid-blue stroke; the interior circle is a soft warm off-white behind the chart. No human figures, no environment, no photographic texture.
img.9.title: Flat Blue Magnifying-Glass Icon Over Ascending Green Bar Chart
img.9.usage_note: Feature or benefit icon where the intended idea is inspection, analysis, discovery, measurement, growth or savings; pairs naturally with copy about evaluating data, finding value, or tracking results.

mark.description: A square, 256x256 raster image containing a solid dark green circular field that fills the frame. Centered on the circle is a single large lowercase letterform 'g' rendered in an off-white / very pale mint tone. The letterform has a closed circular bowl at the top with a round counter, and a lower loop with a wide oval counter, giving the glyph a stacked, figure-eight-like silhouette. The stroke weight is heavy and uniform, with rounded terminals and no serifs. No other text, iconography, imagery or border is visible.

mark.title: Dark Green Circular Mark with White Lowercase 'g'
mark.usage_note: Use as a compact brand mark or avatar-style identifier where a single-letter glyph on a solid circular field is needed: favicon/touch-icon reference, small inline brand chip, list or card thumbnail, or as a reference swatch when matching a dark green + off-white palette. Works best at small to medium sizes where the single glyph stays legible.
